document_metadata.title: 266、INT. RELIANT BRIDGE - FAVORING KHAN
document_metadata.summary: Khan prompts the captain for a delay update while Joachim and others are present, as he speaks into his console.

chunks.content: Joachim over his shoulder. Others in evidence. Khan speaks into his console. KHAN Captain... We're waiting. What's the delay?

metadata.title: 266、INT. RELIANT BRIDGE - FAVORING KHAN
metadata.summary: Khan prompts the captain for a delay update while Joachim and others are present, as he speaks into his console.

document_metadata.title: 267、INT. ROCKY CAVERN (INTERCUT AS DESIRED)
document_metadata.summary: Terrell kills himself after resisting orders; Chekov is freed from a Ceti eel, which Kirk destroys, then seizes the recorder to confront Khan.

chunks.content: All is well, sir. You have the coordinates to beam up Genesis... First things first, Captain. Kill Admiral Kirk. Reactions by all -- only Kirk and Bones are unsurprised. David and Saavik, dazed, fight the urge to do something. Chekov is close to a seizure. Terrell fights conflicting mental signals. Excellency... it is difficult. I try to obey, but -- Kill him. As though tearing off a leach, Terrell grabs at the wrist recorder and flings it to the ground. A shock-wave of pain hits Terrell. He recovers, trembling and tries to obey. Chekov is shaking badly. Terrell aims his phaser at Kirk. Chekov slowly raises his phaser and aims at Terrell, though his hands are like lead. We THINK Chekov is going to do the right thing. Then, shockingly: Terrell turns his phaser on himself.

metadata.title: 267、INT. ROCKY CAVERN (INTERCUT AS DESIRED)
metadata.summary: Terrell kills himself after resisting orders; Chekov is freed from a Ceti eel, which Kirk destroys, then seizes the recorder to confront Khan.

chunks.content: Kill him, Terrell. Now. Terrell does, blowing himself into oblivion. ANGLE - FAVORING CHEKOV He SCREAMS, horribly, drops his phaser, clutching his head. Bones leaps to his side, pulls an injection device from his belt pack, jabs it into Chekov's arm. Chekov, almost with a sigh of relief, drops. Terrell? Chekov -- ! Jim -- for God's sake! They rush to his side, as do Carol and David. ANGLE - FAVORING CHEKOV From the fallen man's ear, something begins to emerge. VERY CLOSE - CHEKOV'S EAR The Ceti eel crawls out. It has grown quite large. SCENE Horror from all. Kirk picks up a phaser. As the eel clears Chekov, he fires and destroys it.He shudders, then sees the wrist recorder and grabs it. Khan, you bloodsucker, they're finished! You'll have to do your own dirty work now. Do you hear me? Do you?

metadata.title: 267、INT. ROCKY CAVERN (INTERCUT AS DESIRED)
metadata.summary: Terrell kills himself after resisting orders; Chekov is freed from a Ceti eel, which Kirk destroys, then seizes the recorder to confront Khan.

document_metadata.title: 268、INT. RELIANT BRIDGE
document_metadata.summary: Khan, having taken Genesis, taunts Kirk, vowing to maroon him on a dead planet and destroy the Enterprise, leaving Kirk helpless and desperate.

chunks.content: Khan reacts to Kirk's VOICE: electronic shock. He clutches the communicator, his eye-whites rolling. KHAN Kirk! Kirk, you are still alive -- my old friend... INTERCUT AS DESIRED WITH ROCKY CAVERN - FAVORING KIRK KIRK Still, 'old friend.' You've managed to kill just about everyone else, but like a poor marksman, you keep missing the target. KHAN (ironic) Perhaps I no longer need to try. He punches several buttons. In the Rocky Cavern the transporter beam locks on to the Genesis torpedo and its arming control box. As Kirk and the others watch, horrified, Khan beams up the materials. David tries to reach the torpedo, but Saavik holds him fast -- DAVID Let go -- he can't -- ! SAAVIK Only half of you would get there.

metadata.title: 268、INT. RELIANT BRIDGE
metadata.summary: Khan, having taken Genesis, taunts Kirk, vowing to maroon him on a dead planet and destroy the Enterprise, leaving Kirk helpless and desperate.

chunks.content: The beam disappears and Genesis with it, leaving them alone. KIRK (desperate) Khan, you have Genesis, but you don't have me! You were going to kill me, Khan, it was your sole purpose. You'll have to come down here to do it! You'll have to come down! KHAN'S VOICE I've done far worse than kill you, Admiral. I've hurt you. And I wish to go on hurting you. I shall leave you, as you left me -- where no one will ever find you: poetic justice; marooned for eternity in the center of a dead planet -- buried alive. KIRK Khan -- !KHAN Goodbye, Admiral. Oh, and don't count on Enterprise. She can't move. My next act will be to blow her out of the heavens. KIRK KHAN! OMITTED

metadata.title: 268、INT. RELIANT BRIDGE
metadata.summary: Khan, having taken Genesis, taunts Kirk, vowing to maroon him on a dead planet and destroy the Enterprise, leaving Kirk helpless and desperate.

document_metadata.title: 269、INT. RELIANT BRIDGE
document_metadata.summary: Khan expresses satisfaction as warp drive remains inoperative, noting they have all the time in the world while other systems are restored.

chunks.content: Khan closes his eyes in voluptuous satisfaction. Joachim enters and Khan looks at him. KHAN Well? JOACHIM Warp drive still inoperative. All other systems should be restored shortly. Khan sighs, contentedly. KHAN Excellent. We have all the time in the world.

metadata.title: 269、INT. RELIANT BRIDGE
metadata.summary: Khan expresses satisfaction as warp drive remains inoperative, noting they have all the time in the world while other systems are restored.

document_metadata.title: 270、INT. ROCKY CAVERN
document_metadata.summary: Kirk prioritizes survival as Carol reveals food in the Genesis cave; David reluctantly leads Bones and Saavik to it while Kirk remains behind, expressing hope for possibilities.

chunks.content: As before, Saavik is on the communicator. SAAVIK This is Lt. Saavik, calling Enterprise... She keeps trying. Chekov stirs -- BONES He's alive! Bones goes and tends Chekov who moans, tries to sit up. KIRK Pavel? Chekov tries to smile; Kirk takes his hand -- SAAVIK No use, Admiral, they're still jamming all channels. BONES (looks across Chekov) It wouldn't make any difference. If Enterprise obeyed orders she's long since gone. And if she couldn't obey, she's finished. DAVID So are we, it looks like. CAROL I don't understand. Who's responsible for all this? Who is Khan? KIRK It's a long story. DAVID We appear to have plenty of time. BONES (dry) You and your father can catch up on things. DAVID (bitter) My father. I hope you realize another man has just been killed because of... BONES Because of you, son. You shouldn't have tried to rush someone holding a primed phaser. Anyway it isn't one man dead, it's two, in case you've lost count. David has been effectively spiked. Long silence.

metadata.title: 270、INT. ROCKY CAVERN
metadata.summary: Kirk prioritizes survival as Carol reveals food in the Genesis cave; David reluctantly leads Bones and Saavik to it while Kirk remains behind, expressing hope for possibilities.

chunks.content: KIRK Do you have anything to eat? I don't know about anyone else, but I'm starved. BONES How can you think of food at a time like this? KIRK Our first order of business is survival. CAROL There's food in the Genesis cave, enough to last a lifetime -- should that be necessary. BONES We thought this was Genesis. Carol laughs -- there's an edge of hysteria to it. CAROL This? It took the Starfleet corps of engineers ten months in space suits to tunnel out all this. What we did in there -- we did in a day. David, why don't you show Dr. McCoy and the Lieutenant our idea of food. DAVID But we can't just sit here -- ! KIRK (unruffled) Oh, yes we can. Is there really something to eat? David looks at his father, who checks his watch, putting on his spectacles. CAROL David. Please. DAVID (to Kirk) This is just to give us something to do, isn't it? (he shrugs) Come on. Saavik and Bones make to follow. Saavik turns to Kirk -- SAAVIK Admiral?KIRK As your teacher Mr. Spock is fond of saying: I like to think there always are possibilities. OMITTED thru thru

metadata.title: 270、INT. ROCKY CAVERN
metadata.summary: Kirk prioritizes survival as Carol reveals food in the Genesis cave; David reluctantly leads Bones and Saavik to it while Kirk remains behind, expressing hope for possibilities.

document_metadata.title: 272、INT. ROCKY CAVERN
document_metadata.summary: Kirk reflects on lost time and fatherhood; Carol comforts him, offering connection and hope as she leads him away to help Chekov.

chunks.content: Carol sits on the ground, Chekov's head in her lap, looking at Kirk. CAROL David was right, wasn't he? It's just to keep them busy. KIRK Why? Why didn't you tell me? CAROL How can you ask me that? Were we together? Where we going to be? You had your world and I had mine. I wanted him in mine, not chasing through the universe with his father. Kirk turns away, overcome. She watches him. CAROL (continuing) He's a lot like you in many ways. Nothing I could do about it. He's smarter, of course; that goes without saying. Most of Genesis is really his. Her joke doesn't take effect. He doesn't turn. CAROL (continuing) This is it, isn't it? We're never going to get out of here. Kirk says nothing. CAROL (continuing) Please. Tell me what you're feeling. Kirk hesitates, comes back and sits next to Chekov; he changes Bones' compress on the ear as he finally speaks.

metadata.title: 272、INT. ROCKY CAVERN
metadata.summary: Kirk reflects on lost time and fatherhood; Carol comforts him, offering connection and hope as she leads him away to help Chekov.

chunks.content: KIRK There's a man I haven't seen in fifteen years who thinks he's killed me. You show me a son who'd almost be happy to help him. My son. My life that could have been and wasn't. What am I feeling? I'm feeling old -- worn out. Carol studies him; gently she sets Chekov's head down on a sweater, then stands. CAROL Let me show you something that will make you feel young -- young as when the world was new. She offers her hand. Kirk looks at Chekov, who smiles, faint assurance. CAROL (continuing) He'll be all right. Come. After a moment's hesitation, Kirk takes her hand and she leads him to the tunnel.

metadata.title: 272、INT. ROCKY CAVERN
metadata.summary: Kirk reflects on lost time and fatherhood; Carol comforts him, offering connection and hope as she leads him away to help Chekov.

document_metadata.title: 273、INT. TUNNEL
document_metadata.summary: Carol and Kirk run toward a glowing light at the end of a tunnel, with Kirk racing ahead, drawn to its blinding, colorful radiance.

chunks.content: TRUCKING BEFORE Carol and Kirk. A rising light falls on their faces as they walk, then run with excitement toward the source. Kirk races ahead... KIRK'S POV - MOVING THROUGH THE TUNNEL toward an iridescent light at its end, blindingly beautiful with color. INTERCUT: THESE TWO ANGLES until WE CAN HARDLY WAIT for Kirk to reach the end of the tunnel, and then, when it does:

metadata.title: 273、INT. TUNNEL
metadata.summary: Carol and Kirk run toward a glowing light at the end of a tunnel, with Kirk racing ahead, drawn to its blinding, colorful radiance.

document_metadata.title: 274、INT. GENESIS CAVE - PROMONTORY LEVEL
document_metadata.summary: Kirk exits a rock tunnel into a vast, Eden-like cavern with lush growth, waterfalls, a blue sky, and a glowing orb; Carol joins him, explaining the rapid growth of life forms in the newly formed matrix.

chunks.content: where the rock tunnel ends. Kirk comes out of the tunnel, and his mouth drops open. FULL SHOT - THE GENESIS CAVE (MATTE AND FX) (FORMERLY SCENE A huge cavern. Kirk is actually standing at the middle of it. Space extends vastly above and below his point of view. Like Eden, lush growth everywhere, waterfalls, and a cobalt blue sky high, high above where a round orb glows sending light and warmth downward. There is a path from where Kirk stands down to the lower level where Bones, and the others are waiting and calling to him. Mist and haze waft gently across the cavern.

metadata.title: 274、INT. GENESIS CAVE - PROMONTORY LEVEL
metadata.summary: Kirk exits a rock tunnel into a vast, Eden-like cavern with lush growth, waterfalls, a blue sky, and a glowing orb; Carol joins him, explaining the rapid growth of life forms in the newly formed matrix.

chunks.content: BACK TO KIRK as Carol comes up beside him. KIRK You did this -- in a day?! CAROL The matrix formed in a day. The life forms grew later -- at a wildly accelerated rate. Can I cook or can't I?

metadata.title: 274、INT. GENESIS CAVE - PROMONTORY LEVEL

document_metadata.title: 277、INT. RELIANT BRIDGE

chunks.content: JOACHIM Departing dark side, Regula. KHAN Visual -- ON SCREEN The Regula I Space Station -- but where is Enterprise? ON KHAN frowning with puzzlement. KHAN Where IS she? ON SCREEN not a trace!

document_metadata.title: 278、INT. GENESIS CAVE PLATFORM
document_metadata.summary: Kirk and others eat fruit in a forest; Chekov joins them. Saavik and David exchange tense, awkward glances, acknowledging their connection.

chunks.content: Kirk and the others eat fruit from the huge (matte) forest beyond. Chekov has been moved to join them. ANGLE FAVORING DAVID AND SAAVIK who watches him. DAVID What are you looking at? SAAVIK The Admiral's son. DAVID Don't you believe it. SAAVIK Oh, I believe it. She almost smiles. David returns her stare and it throws her. SAAVIK (continuing) What are you looking at? DAVID (confused) I don't know.

metadata.title: 278、INT. GENESIS CAVE PLATFORM
metadata.summary: Kirk and others eat fruit in a forest; Chekov joins them. Saavik and David exchange tense, awkward glances, acknowledging their connection.

document_metadata.title: 279、INT. GENESIS CAVE - WIDER ANGLE
document_metadata.summary: Kirk asserts he faces death daily, reiterates he doesn't like to lose, and coordinates with Spock for transport, impressing those around him.

chunks.content: Saavik rises, paces. Kirk puts down his food. KIRK Now that's what I call a meal. BONES It's like the Garden of Eden... CAROL Only here, every apple comes from the Tree of Knowledge. Kirk watches Saavik. KIRK What's on your mind, Lieutenant? SAAVIK The Kobayashi Maru, sir. DAVID The what? BONES The no-win scenario -- and with what philosophy a commander faces defeat. KIRK Are you asking me if we are playing out that scenario now, Lieutenant? SAAVIK On the test, sir, will you tell me what you did? I'd really like to know. Kirk looks at Bones, who smiles -- BONES Lieutenant, you are looking at the only Starfleet cadet who ever beat the no-win scenario -- KIRK And almost got tossed out of the Academy... He looks at his watch again, using his glasses -- SAAVIK How? KIRK I reprogrammed the simulation so it was possible to rescue the ship. SAAVIK WHAT? KIRK I changed the conditions of the test. I received a commendation for original thinking. (pause) I don't like to lose.

metadata.title: 279、INT. GENESIS CAVE - WIDER ANGLE
metadata.summary: Kirk asserts he faces death daily, reiterates he doesn't like to lose, and coordinates with Spock for transport, impressing those around him.

chunks.content: SAAVIK Then -- you never faced that situation -- faced death... BONES Until now. KIRK We each face death every day we're alive, Saavik. He picks up the communicator. KIRK (continuing) Spock, this is Kirk. It's two hours. Are you about ready? SPOCK'S VOICE Right on schedule, Admiral. Just give us your coordinates and we'll beam you aboard. The others are on their feet, stunned with amazement -- KIRK Right. I don't like to lose. He clicks off. David gapes at his father.

metadata.title: 279、INT. GENESIS CAVE - WIDER ANGLE
metadata.summary: Kirk asserts he faces death daily, reiterates he doesn't like to lose, and coordinates with Spock for transport, impressing those around him.

chunks.content: WE CAN SEE NOW where Enterprise is: she has slipped behind the plantoid, clockwise, even as Reliant was rounding into the lighted side.

document_metadata.title: 281、INT. TRANSPORTER ROOM - ENTERPRISE
document_metadata.summary: Spock admits to exaggerating the timeline to buy time, sparking tension over protocol; Kirk stresses urgency as Bones takes Chekov to sick bay, while David quietly observes the escalating crisis.

chunks.content: Kirk, David, Saavik, Carol and Bones, holding the semi-conscious Chekov, MATERIALIZE. Spock is there to greet them. Saavik immediately raises concern about the damage report, insisting they were immobilized. Kirk gently chides her, urging her to rely on regulation rather than panic, and cites Regulation 46-A regarding coded transmissions during battle. Saavik, still focused on procedure, completes the quote, showing her strict adherence to the rules.

metadata.title: 281、INT. TRANSPORTER ROOM - ENTERPRISE
metadata.summary: Spock admits to exaggerating the timeline to buy time, sparking tension over protocol; Kirk stresses urgency as Bones takes Chekov to sick bay, while David quietly observes the escalating crisis.

chunks.content: She steps in front of Spock, confronting him with the accusation: 'You lied.' Spock calmly corrects her—'I exaggerated'—clarifying that he extended the timeline to buy them time. Kirk elaborates that what was once hours has now been reduced to minutes, underscoring the urgency. The exchange highlights the tension between protocol and tactical deception, with Spock and Kirk justifying their actions under pressure.Bones interrupts, announcing he’s taking Chekov and the others to sick bay. The camera lingers on David, who stands in quiet awe, absorbing the intensity of the moment and the weight of the unfolding crisis, his expression reflecting a mix of concern and reverence as the scene shifts focus toward the personal stakes amid the chaos.

metadata.title: 281、INT. TRANSPORTER ROOM - ENTERPRISE
metadata.summary: Spock admits to exaggerating the timeline to buy time, sparking tension over protocol; Kirk stresses urgency as Bones takes Chekov to sick bay, while David quietly observes the escalating crisis.

chunks.content: Saavik and Kirk follow Spock. They stop at a Turbo Lift -- SPOCK They're inoperative below C-deck.

metadata.title: 282、INT. CORRIDOR ENTERPRISE

document_metadata.title: 283、INT. ANOTHER ENTERPRISE CORRIDOR
document_metadata.summary: Kirk and Spock race through corridors discussing limited progress on restoring main power, achieving only partial success in two hours.

chunks.content: They race down corridors as they speak -- KIRK What IS working around here? SPOCK Not much, Admiral. We have partial main power... KIRK That's it? SPOCK Best we could do in two hours.

metadata.title: 283、INT. ANOTHER ENTERPRISE CORRIDOR
metadata.summary: Kirk and Spock race through corridors discussing limited progress on restoring main power, achieving only partial success in two hours.

document_metadata.title: 284、INT. ENTERPRISE BRIDGE
document_metadata.summary: Kirk leads the Enterprise into the Mutara Nebula, where static and gas impair systems, leveling the odds against the Reliant as Spock notes the mutual disadvantage.

chunks.content: Full crew in place as doors whoosh open -- SULU (overjoyed) Admiral on the bridge -- KIRK Battle stations. ALARMS, SIRENS, ETC. CREW RUSH INTO PLACE AS Kirk, Spock and Saavik approach the big screen. KIRK (continuing) Tactical. We see the Enterprise emerging from the dark side of Gamma Regula, where Reliant is now a moving blip. KIRK (continuing) Uh oh. SPOCK She can out-run us and out-gun us. But there is the Mutara Nebula at mark four. KIRK (studies his console) Scotty, can we make it inside? SCOTTY The energizer's bypassed like a Christmas tree -- so don't give me too many bumps. KIRK No promises, Mr. Scott. On your way.

metadata.title: 284、INT. ENTERPRISE BRIDGE
metadata.summary: Kirk leads the Enterprise into the Mutara Nebula, where static and gas impair systems, leveling the odds against the Reliant as Spock notes the mutual disadvantage.

chunks.content: SAAVIK Trouble with the nebula, sir, is all that static discharge and gas clouds our tactical display. Visuals won't function and shields will be useless. Kirk looks over the rims of his glasses at Spock; they smile with faint amusement. SPOCK What's sauce for the goose, Mr. Saavik. The odds will be even.

metadata.title: 284、INT. ENTERPRISE BRIDGE
metadata.summary: Kirk leads the Enterprise into the Mutara Nebula, where static and gas impair systems, leveling the odds against the Reliant as Spock notes the mutual disadvantage.

chunks.content: Reacting. Saavik approaches Kirk and Spock. SAAVIK Admiral... what happens if Reliant fails to follow us into the nebula? Kirk and Spock exchange looks -- SPOCK I think we can guarantee she'll follow us, Mr. Saavik. Remind me to explain to you the concept of human ego. KIRK Best speed, Scotty...

chunks.content: KHAN There! Full impulse power! Not so wounded as we were led to believe -- so much the better...

chunks.content: Call them SPACE-BYS. Enterprise rushes TOWARD US, flashes BY and CONTINUES towards the swirling nebula. THEN Reliant does the same, closer in pursuit. At this moment, half the distance between Regula and the nebula has been covered.

document_metadata.title: 296、INT. ENTERPRISE HOSPITAL
document_metadata.summary: The ship is hit, Chekov wakes disoriented, McCoy restrains him; Carol volunteers to help in surgery as the Enterprise takes another hit.

chunks.content: The ship reverberates with the near miss. Chekov wakes up, looks wildly about -- BONES Take it easy -- CHEKOV But I must -- BONES Listen to me, Pavel; you haven't the strength or the equilibrium -- CHEKOV But -- As they talk, David, unnoticed, leaves the area. The Enterprise is buffeted again -- CAROL Dr. McCoy, I can't just sit here. Tell me what I can do. BONES (grim) You can help get my surgery squared away. I'm expecting customers. She whitens in fear. ANOTHER SHOT reverberates.

document_metadata.title: 297、INT. ENTERPRISE BRIDGE
document_metadata.summary: Kirk and crew approach a nebula as David enters the bridge; Saavik notices him while Spock reports enemy ships slowing, and Uhura prepares communications.

chunks.content: SAAVIK That was close -- KIRK (unfazed) They just don't want us going in there. SPOCK One minute to nebula perimeter. The bridge door slides open and David enters. He stares in wonder. Saavik reacts to David. SPOCK (continuing) Admiral, they're reducing speed. KIRK Uhura, patch me in -- UHURA Aye, sir.

metadata.summary: Kirk and crew approach a nebula as David enters the bridge; Saavik notices him while Spock reports enemy ships slowing, and Uhura prepares communications.

document_metadata.title: 298、INT. RELIANT BRIDGE
document_metadata.summary: Khan, defying warnings, activates full impulse power to pursue Kirk into a nebula despite shield vulnerabilities, provoked by Kirk's taunting challenge.

chunks.content: KHAN Why are we slowing? JOACHIM We daren't follow them into the nebula, sir -- our shields will be useless... KIRK'S VOICE This is Admiral Kirk. Khan's eyes bulge -- KIRK'S VOICE (continuing) We tried it once your way, Khan. Are you game for a rematch? Khan's eyes bulge -- KIRK'S VOICE (continuing) Khan -- ! I'm laughing at the "superior" intellect. KHAN Full impulse power! JOACHIM No sir! We have Genesis -- Whatever you want -- KHAN Full power damn you ! And he reaches across and executes it himself.

metadata.title: 298、INT. RELIANT BRIDGE
metadata.summary: Khan, defying warnings, activates full impulse power to pursue Kirk into a nebula despite shield vulnerabilities, provoked by Kirk's taunting challenge.

metadata.summary: Kirk comments on Reliant's consistent speed-up as the nebula approach is shown on screen.

chunks.content: WE'RE VERY CLOSE NOW, and SEE CLEARLY the swirling, slowly moving gases, magenta, purple, etc. There are veils of luminescent materials and through all an interlace of unpredictable electrical charges. Like lightning, these intermittent great flashes illumine whole sections of the nebula. OUR VIEW is moving slowly forward...

metadata.summary: Approaching a nebula with swirling magenta and purple gases, illuminated by intermittent lightning-like flashes through luminescent veils.

document_metadata.title: 303、INT. RELIANT BRIDGE
document_metadata.summary: The ship's systems fail with purple static on screen; Khan orders shields up, but Joachim reports they're inoperative and reduces speed amid electrical disturbances.

chunks.content: ON SCREEN the picture is squirrelly purple, breaking up. Blindness. Panic. KHAN Tactical! JOACHIM (tries) Inoperative. KHAN Raise the shields... Electrical forces raging without are also reflected on the circuits within. It's bumpy, on top of everything else. Electronic WHINING. JOACHIM As I feared, sir. Not functional. I'm reducing speed. Khan does not argue.

metadata.summary: The ship's systems fail with purple static on screen; Khan orders shields up, but Joachim reports they're inoperative and reduces speed amid electrical disturbances.

chunks.content: Cautiously Reliant emerges from a massive "cloudbank." Electrical discharges abound. Barely moving, she feels her way forward. Alone. AS THE ANGLE WIDENS A treat: Enterprise is above and behind Reliant.

metadata.title: 319、INT. ENTERPRISE BRIDGE

chunks.content: KIRK Spock? Spock is bent over the scanner -- SPOCK Sporadic energy readings port side, aft. Could be an impulse turn. KIRK He won't break off now. If he followed me this far he'll be back. But from where...? SPOCK He's intelligent, but not experienced. His pattern indicates two dimensional thinking... Kirk looks at him, smiles.KIRK Mr. Saavik, all stop. SAAVIK All stop, sir. KIRK Descend ten thousand meters. Stand by photon torpedoes.

document_metadata.title: 324、INT. ENTERPRISE BRIDGE
document_metadata.summary: Enterprise fires torpedoes at Reliant, destroying its weapons pod, causing significant damage, blasting off its port engine, and devastating the bridge, leaving Khan's fate uncertain.

chunks.content: Reliant ON SCREEN, intermittent but clear. CHEKOV Torpedoes ready, sir. KIRK Fire. SERIES OF SHOTS A) EXT. ENTERPRISE fires torpedo; one which hits, destroying Reliant's weapons pod on top. B) INT. RELIANT C) EXPLOSIONS rock the interior of Reliant. D) EXT. ENTERPRISE fires two more times. The first causes general damage. The second, close behind blasts Reliant's port engine off into space, debris scattering. E) INT. RELIANT BRIDGE is devastated. Khan is blown from his chair and WE'RE UNCERTAIN of his fate.

document_metadata.title: 326、INT. ENTERPRISE BRIDGE
document_metadata.summary: Kirk orders cease fire and prepares to board Reliant; Scott reports needing ten minutes to restore power due to radiation, while Saavik notes low power levels.

chunks.content: No cheers, just deadly professionalism. KIRK Cease fire. Look sharp. SAAVIK Power levels quite low, sir. KIRK (to intercom) Mr. Scott, can you get the mains back on line? SCOTTY'S VOICE (breaking up slightly) I'll need ten minutes, sir, 'til the radiation dissipates. KIRK Uhura, send to Commander, Reliant: prepare to be boarded. UHURA Aye, sir.

metadata.title: 326、INT. ENTERPRISE BRIDGE
metadata.summary: Kirk orders cease fire and prepares to board Reliant; Scott reports needing ten minutes to restore power due to radiation, while Saavik notes low power levels.

document_metadata.title: 327、INT. RELIANT BRIDGE
document_metadata.summary: Khan, severely burned but alive, defies Kirk as he uses his remaining strength to arm the Genesis device aboard Reliant despite Enterprise's demand to surrender.

chunks.content: Amid the smoke and ruins, WE SEE no signs of life. UHURA'S VOICE Commander, Reliant, this is Enterprise. Surrender and prepare to be boarded. Repeat... In f.g., chillingly, Khan rises INTO SHOT by the main console. He is horribly burned, and it is clear that he is clinging to life by his will. KHAN No... Kirk. The game's not over. As Uhura's voice continues O.S., Khan pulls himself into a chair at the console, one of his hands useless at his side. KHAN (continuing) To the last I will grapple with thee! Painfully, with one good arm, he starts arming the Genesis console.

metadata.title: 327、INT. RELIANT BRIDGE
metadata.summary: Khan, severely burned but alive, defies Kirk as he uses his remaining strength to arm the Genesis device aboard Reliant despite Enterprise's demand to surrender.

document_metadata.title: 328、INT. RELIANT TRANSPORTER ROOM
document_metadata.summary: The CHILD from Ceti Alpha approaches the Genesis torpedo, which activates with blinking lights, and smiles at it.

chunks.content: There sits the Genesis torpedo: lights start blinking in response. As we watch, the CHILD we met on Ceti Alpha walks to the torpedo and smiles at the lights.

metadata.title: 328、INT. RELIANT TRANSPORTER ROOM
metadata.summary: The CHILD from Ceti Alpha approaches the Genesis torpedo, which activates with blinking lights, and smiles at it.

document_metadata.title: 329、INT. ENTERPRISE BRIDGE
document_metadata.summary: Kirk orders warp speed in three minutes to stop the Genesis Wave; Spock leaves the bridge, and Saavik prepares to depart at best speed.

chunks.content: UHURA Enterprise to Reliant: you are ordered to surrender your vessel. Respond! (to Kirk) Nothing, sir. KIRK We'll beam aboard. Alert transporter room -- SPOCK Admiral. Scanning an energy source on Reliant. A pattern I've never seen. David peers closer over Spock's shoulder, reacts. DAVID It's the Genesis Wave! KIRK What? DAVID He's on a build up to detonation!

metadata.title: 329、INT. ENTERPRISE BRIDGE
metadata.summary: Kirk orders warp speed in three minutes to stop the Genesis Wave; Spock leaves the bridge, and Saavik prepares to depart at best speed.

chunks.content: KIRK How soon -- DAVID We encoded four minutes -- KIRK We'll beam aboard and stop it -- DAVID You can't! The briefest stunned moment. Kirk hits intercom: KIRK Scotty, I need warp speed in three minutes or we're all dead! STATIC. KIRK (continuing) Scotty!Spock leaps from his place and disappears through the bridge doors. KIRK (continuing) Saavik, get us out, best speed! SAAVIK Aye, sir.

metadata.title: 329、INT. ENTERPRISE BRIDGE
metadata.summary: Kirk orders warp speed in three minutes to stop the Genesis Wave; Spock leaves the bridge, and Saavik prepares to depart at best speed.

document_metadata.title: 331、INT. RELIANT BRIDGE
document_metadata.summary: Khan, dying, expresses hatred as Enterprise retreats; an electronic whine intensifies.

chunks.content: ON SCREEN, Enterprise, intermittent image, backs away. Khan smiles triumphantly through his pain. An elec- tronic power SOUND has been building. KHAN No... You can't get away... From hell's heart I stab at thee... (amid the pain) For hate's sake... I spit my last breath at thee! Khan topples forward, dead. The WHINE continues to build chillingly.

metadata.title: 331、INT. RELIANT BRIDGE
metadata.summary: Khan, dying, expresses hatred as Enterprise retreats; an electronic whine intensifies.

document_metadata.title: 332、INT. ENTERPRISE ENGINE ROOM
document_metadata.summary: Spock enters a highly radioactive reactor room despite Bones' warnings, incapacitates him with a nerve pinch, and proceeds as Scotty pleads for him to stop.

chunks.content: Spock rushes in. Bones ministers to Scotty, b.g. Spock sizes up the situation, starts for the radiation room, Bones intercepts him. BONES Are you out of your Vulcan mind? No human can tolerate the radiation loose in there! SPOCK But, as you are so fond of observing, Doctor, I'm not human. BONES You're not going in there -- ! SPOCK I'm afraid I can't stop to discuss this logically -- He gives Bones the Vulcan nerve pinch. Bones goes down. Spock presses the access button and enters the Reactor Room, a separated area behind radiation-proof glass and metal, RED FLASHING LIGHTS and an iridescent blue glow within. ANGLE - SCOTTY AND BONES SCOTTY (in horror) Spock -- get out of there!

metadata.title: 332、INT. ENTERPRISE ENGINE ROOM

chunks.content: Bathed in blue light, arcing energy around him, Spock is a silhouetted figure as he goes to work, door clos- ing behind him.

metadata.summary: Spock, illuminated by blue light with arcing energy, is silhouetted as he works, a door closing behind him.

chunks.content: KIRK Time from my mark... SAAVIK Two minutes, ten seconds. KIRK (intercom) Engine room! What's happening?!

document_metadata.title: 337、INT. ENTERPRISE REACTOR ROOM (INTERCUT AS
document_metadata.summary: Spock endures lethal radiation, hands burning as he manually stabilizes the system, while Scotty and Bones watch in silent horror, unable to help.

chunks.content: Outside the glass, Scotty and Bones are screaming in desperation: SCOTTY Captain, please! BONES Get out! Get out, man! Oh, dear God...! Within, we can see the silent, frantic urging of Bones and Scotty, their faces pressed against the glass, helpless. Spock remains oblivious to their cries, fully focused on his task amidst the fire-blue arcs of energy that crackle around him.

metadata.title: 337、INT. ENTERPRISE REACTOR ROOM (INTERCUT AS
metadata.summary: Spock endures lethal radiation, hands burning as he manually stabilizes the system, while Scotty and Bones watch in silent horror, unable to help.

chunks.content: He moves to the control panel, and between his hands and the controls, power arcs wildly, creating an inferno of radiation. Spock is in a hellish environment, fighting with all his strength to stabilize the system. Slowly, the damping rods begin to move into place. He then turns to a manual control, gripping it tightly, his hands already beginning to blacken from the intense radiation.CLOSE on Spock's hands as they slowly turn black, burning from the lethal exposure. His face shows immense pain, yet he continues to work, using every ounce of Vulcan discipline to suppress his agony and complete the task. WITHOUT Bones and Scotty react in helpless horror, witnessing the sacrifice unfold in silence.

metadata.title: 337、INT. ENTERPRISE REACTOR ROOM (INTERCUT AS
metadata.summary: Spock endures lethal radiation, hands burning as he manually stabilizes the system, while Scotty and Bones watch in silent horror, unable to help.

chunks.content: Reliant, now symbol of death, ON SCREEN. KIRK Time! SAAVIK Three minutes, thirty seconds. KIRK Distance from Reliant... CHEKOV Four hundred kilometers. Kirk looks at David, but David shakes his head: No way. Then: CADET Sir! The mains are back on line -- ! KIRK Bless you, Scotty. Go, Saavik! She increases power and --

document_metadata.title: 340、EXT. SPACE NEBULA - SERIES OF SHOTS
document_metadata.summary: Enterprise accelerates away from Reliant, which triggers a massive Genesis Effect within the Mutara Nebula, causing a cosmic-scale explosion with blinding flash and turbulence.

chunks.content: A) With a burst of warp speed, Enterprise accelerates out of the lazy pace and whooshes PUT OF SCENE, leaving Reliant behind. B) POV RELIANT disappearing in the swirls of: C) POV MUTARA NEBULA which clears the flame and -- D) ENTERPRISE roaring through space -- and: E) RELIANT The WHINE increases to fever pitch, then: she goes! F) EXT. MUTARA NEBULA - MASTER EFFECT As Reliant goes, so goes the nebula. The "Genesis Effect" WE SAW in its earliest experiments, now seems familiar on a gigantic, cosmic scale. The blinding flash at first, followed by the same tumbling turbulence of the miniature test. It is awesome.

metadata.title: 340、EXT. SPACE NEBULA - SERIES OF SHOTS
metadata.summary: Enterprise accelerates away from Reliant, which triggers a massive Genesis Effect within the Mutara Nebula, causing a cosmic-scale explosion with blinding flash and turbulence.

document_metadata.title: 341、INT. ENTERPRISE BRIDGE
document_metadata.summary: Carol appears as the bridge doors open; Kirk slows the ship, witnesses Genesis evolving, and rushes to the engine room after Bones urgently calls him.

chunks.content: The bridge doors open and Carol appears. Instinctively she draws near her son. Finally, Kirk turns, sees Carol -- KIRK Reduce speed. My God, Carl. Look at it. ON SCREEN and INTERCUT -- GENESIS TUMBLES and starts evolving. A moment in history. KIRK (continuing, on intercom) Engine Room. Well done. Scotty? BONES' VOICE (after a beat) Jim, you'd better get down here. Hurry. The tone frightens Kirk. KIRK Saavik, take the con. He moves through the doors quickly, leaving the rest staring at the new world evolving.

metadata.title: 341、INT. ENTERPRISE BRIDGE

document_metadata.title: 345、INT. ENTERPRISE ENGINE ROOM
document_metadata.summary: Spock dies after revealing his solution to the Kobayashi Maru test, sharing a final moment with Kirk, who is devastated as the crew discovers a new Genesis world.

chunks.content: Kirk emerges to encounter Scotty and Bones. Their looks tell him. He sees the flashing light over the Reactor Room. He dashes for the control panel. Bones grabs him. SCOTTY No, sir! You'll flood the whole compartment...! KIRK He'll die -- ! BONES (also holds him) He's dead already, Jim. Kirk's eyes bulge. KIRK Oh, God. ANGLE AT REACTOR ROOM GLASS DOOR With stunned understanding, Kirk stumbles to the door, sees Spock on his knees, hands blackened, face cracked with radiation lines and scars. Spock shakes his head. With a feeble hand he reaches the intercom button: filtered communication. KIRK Spock! SPOCK The ship -- out of danger? KIRK Yes -- Spock is satisfied; he fights for breath -- SPOCK Don't grieve, Admiral -- it's logical: the good of the many outweighs -- He almost keels over. Kirk has tears streaming down his face. KIRK ... the good of the few... SPOCK Or the one.

metadata.title: 345、INT. ENTERPRISE ENGINE ROOM
metadata.summary: Spock dies after revealing his solution to the Kobayashi Maru test, sharing a final moment with Kirk, who is devastated as the crew discovers a new Genesis world.

chunks.content: He props a hand on the glass to support himself. Kirk's hand reflexively goes to match Spock's on the other side of the glass -- SPOCK (continuing) I never took the Kobayashi Maru test -- until now. What do you think of my solution? KIRK Spock...! SPOCK I have been -- and always will be -- your friend... Live. Long. And. Prosper. Spock falls. Bones and Scotty react. KIRK No...! SAAVIK'S VOICE (intercom) Admiral, you've got to see this! There's new life -- a whole new world, a Genesis world -- ! But Kirk is past hearing or caring. He is huddled up against the glass, destroyed. Bones looks on, helpless.DISSOLVE TO:

metadata.title: 345、INT. ENTERPRISE ENGINE ROOM
metadata.summary: Spock dies after revealing his solution to the Kobayashi Maru test, sharing a final moment with Kirk, who is devastated as the crew discovers a new Genesis world.

document_metadata.title: 346、EXT. SPACE
document_metadata.summary: The crew honors a fallen comrade with a space burial; Saavik leads the commendation, Sulu commands honors, Scotty plays Amazing Grace, and the capsule is launched into space.

chunks.content: A spectacular look at Carol's planet being born! OMITTED CAMERA PULLS BACK TO REVEAL the Ship's Company in full dress uniforms assembled for ship's burial service. Over the PULLBACK, we HEAR: KIRK In accordance with the traditions of Starfleet and of Article Starfleet Regulations, we are assembled here today to pay final respects to our honored dead. Carol and David are PROMINENTLY FEATURED. David watching Kirk attentively. So are Sulu, Uhura, Chekov, and Saavik. Bones stands next to Kirk. Scotty carries his bagpipes. Saavik wears her hair down. KIRK (continuing) And yet, in the midst of our sorrow it should be noted that this death takes place in the shadow of new life, the sunrise of a new world, a world that our beloved comrade gave his own life to protect and nourish. He did not feel that sacrifice a vain or empty one -- and we will not debate his profound wisdom, in these proceedings. Of my friend, I can only say this, that of all the souls I have encountered in my travels, his was the most -- (he falters) -- human. He tries to go on, but catches Bones' face: Bones is streaming tears. Kirk can't go on.

metadata.title: 346、EXT. SPACE
metadata.summary: The crew honors a fallen comrade with a space burial; Saavik leads the commendation, Sulu commands honors, Scotty plays Amazing Grace, and the capsule is launched into space.

chunks.content: KIRK (continuing) Lieutenant Saavik. OMITTED ANGLE - THE GROUP Saavik steps forward. SAAVIK We commend the soul of our brother departed. We love we commit his body to the depths of space. SULU Honors -- hup! All Starfleet personnel salute. Scotty begins to PIPE, an odd blare which mellows into Amazing Grace. Kirk nods a signal.THE CAPSULE A gleaming black projectile is carried by pallbearers into the launching chamber, which locks behind it. At a hand signal from a TORPEDOMAN, the projectile is fired. NOISE.

metadata.title: 346、EXT. SPACE
metadata.summary: The crew honors a fallen comrade with a space burial; Saavik leads the commendation, Sulu commands honors, Scotty plays Amazing Grace, and the capsule is launched into space.

document_metadata.summary: Spock's remains are sent toward a new world in a capsule that becomes too small to see, accompanied by bagpipes that eventually stop.

chunks.content: Spock's remains seen on their way to the new world. The capsule grows too small to SEE. The bagpipes STOP.

metadata.title: 347、EXT. SPACE
metadata.summary: Spock's remains are sent toward a new world in a capsule that becomes too small to see, accompanied by bagpipes that eventually stop.

document_metadata.title: 348、INT. TORPEDO ROOM
document_metadata.summary: Kirk orders Saavik to set course for Ceti Alpha V to rescue survivors, then retires to his quarters as Saavik takes command and dismisses the company.

chunks.content: SULU Return -- hup! The salute drop. KIRK Lieutenant. She steps to him and they exchange salutes -- KIRK (continuing; very quietly) After you dismiss the company, you will take the watch. Set course for Ceti Alpha V and we'll pick up survivors. SAAVIK Aye, sir. KIRK I'll be in my quarters if needed, but I would prefer... SAAVIK Understood, sir. KIRK (aloud) Dismiss the company. They salute. She about-faces as Kirk walks towards the Turbo Lift. Saavik issues dismissal and posting orders, but WE TRUCK with Kirk until CAMERA STOPS and he leaves FRAME and WE HOLD on David. He finally understands.

metadata.title: 348、INT. TORPEDO ROOM
metadata.summary: Kirk orders Saavik to set course for Ceti Alpha V to rescue survivors, then retires to his quarters as Saavik takes command and dismisses the company.

document_metadata.title: 349、INT. KIRK'S QUARTERS
document_metadata.summary: Kirk and David reconcile as David expresses pride in being his son; their emotional embrace reflects shared grief and newfound understanding, helping Kirk confront his guilt and mortality.

chunks.content: After a long moment, the CAMERA DISCOVERS Kirk. He pours a drink, then decides not to have it. He sits wearily, not knowing how to shake the ghosts. Then he sees the book. Kirk picks up the battered volume, the gift from his friend, and closes his eyes a moment. Almost idly he starts turning pages, looking for a clue. But he can't see the writing -- he rummages through his pockets and pulls out the half-glasses -- One of the lenses is broken. It has a deep impact on Kirk. He puts down the book and glasses and covers his eyes. A SOFT BONG. Kirk clears his throat. KIRK Yes... come. The door whooshes open and closes to admit David. The last person Kirk expected to see. DAVID I don't mean to intrude. KIRK Uh, no... (rises) I should be on the bridge. DAVID Are you running away from me? David's strength is turning a corner with Kirk -- KIRK I suppose I was. (pause) I poured a drink. Would you like it? DAVID No. I -- I guess I'm not what you expected. KIRK (rueful) I didn't expect anything. DAVID That makes two of us. (he studies his father) Lieutenant Saavik was right: you never have faced death -- KIRK (hoarse) Not like this -- no. I haven't faced death, I cheated death. I tricked my way out of death and patted myself on the back for my ingenuity. I know nothing.

metadata.title: 349、INT. KIRK'S QUARTERS
metadata.summary: Kirk and David reconcile as David expresses pride in being his son; their emotional embrace reflects shared grief and newfound understanding, helping Kirk confront his guilt and mortality.

chunks.content: DAVID You knew enough to tell Saavik that how we face death is at least as important as how we face life -- KIRK It was just words. DAVID But good words. That's where ideas begin. Maybe you should listen to them. KIRK I'm trying, David. DAVID So am I. My friends were killed, too. KIRK I am truly sorry. Pause. They study each other. DAVID I was wrong about you. And I'm sorry. KIRK Is that what you came here to say? DAVID Mainly. (he starts out, then turns -- ) And also that I'm proud -- very proud -- to be your son.A stunned moment, then Kirk lets it all hang out: for David, for Carol and for Spock. He hugs his son, hold- ing onto him as if to life itself.

metadata.title: 349、INT. KIRK'S QUARTERS
metadata.summary: Kirk and David reconcile as David expresses pride in being his son; their emotional embrace reflects shared grief and newfound understanding, helping Kirk confront his guilt and mortality.

document_metadata.title: 350、EXT. SPACE
document_metadata.summary: The Enterprise passes a beautiful new planet.

chunks.content: The Enterprise passes the new planet in all its beauty.

metadata.title: 350、EXT. SPACE
metadata.summary: The Enterprise passes a beautiful new planet.

document_metadata.title: 351、INT. ENTERPRISE BRIDGE
document_metadata.summary: Kirk reflects on Spock's words, feels young, and gives Saavik a new course as the crew prepares to move on, honoring their friend.

chunks.content: The door whooshes. Kirk strides on the bridge, David with him. Carol is there with Bones; they are glad at what they see. SAAVIK Admiral on the bridge! KIRK As you were, Mr. Saavik. SAAVIK Aye, sir. On course to Ceti Alpha. All is well. KIRK Good, I believe you already know my, uh, son -- Saavik comes close to blushing -- KIRK (continuing) Yes, well, why don't you show him around and... SAAVIK Aye, sir -- She takes him off, deadpan amusement -- SAAVIK (continuing) So you turn out to be the dumb bastard. They stare at her. SAAVIK (continuing) That is a little joke. Kirk has a smile. He joins Bones and Carol facing the screen. BONES She's changed her hair again. (pause) Will you look at that? Think they'll name it for you, Doctor?

metadata.title: 351、INT. ENTERPRISE BRIDGE
metadata.summary: Kirk reflects on Spock's words, feels young, and gives Saavik a new course as the crew prepares to move on, honoring their friend.

chunks.content: CAROL Not if I can help it. We'll name it for our friend. KIRK (quietly) It is a far far better thing I do than I have ever done before... a far better resting place I go to than I have ever known... CAROL (soft) Is that a poem? KIRK Something Spock was trying to tell me. On my birthday. He shakes his head, remembering -- BONES You okay, Jim? How do you feel? KIRK (considers; smiles) Young. I feel young, Doctor. He turns to Saavik and David -- KIRK (continuing) Lieutenant, new course: 'Second star to the right and straight on till morning.' The bridge crackles with lights and CHATTER as we...CUT TO: THE VIEWSCREEN AND GO THROUGH TO:

metadata.title: 351、INT. ENTERPRISE BRIDGE
metadata.summary: Kirk reflects on Spock's words, feels young, and gives Saavik a new course as the crew prepares to move on, honoring their friend.

document_metadata.title: 352、EXT. SPACE FINALE (BOARDED)
document_metadata.summary: The Starship Enterprise embarks on its mission to explore new worlds and civilizations, venturing boldly into space as it departs toward the stars.

chunks.content: SPOCK'S VOICE Space, the final frontier... These are the continuing voyages of the Starship Enterprise... Her ongoing mission: to explore strange new worlds... to seek out new life and new civilizations... To boldly go where no man has gone before... She is moving out now, passing CAMERA and heading toward the distant stars. She is beautiful and they are beautiful. And as she slowly disappears from VIEW... MUSIC RISES. CREDITS ROLL. THE END

metadata.title: 352、EXT. SPACE FINALE (BOARDED)
metadata.summary: The Starship Enterprise embarks on its mission to explore new worlds and civilizations, venturing boldly into space as it departs toward the stars.
